gaps.what: Dates and takers of Cliopatria's undated shape changes (confidence 1, 47 events): Corsica 732, Balearics and Ceuta 718, Sardinia 840, Bitola 788, Macedonia 852 and 860, northern Apulia 1046, Brindisi 1056, Calabria 1066, Zeta 1056 and Raska 1066, Cilicia 1139 and 1147, Hungary lands 1188, Afyon 1188, Cyprus 1192, Skopje 1285, Anatolia 1305 and 1314, Serres 1385, Thessalonica 1403 and 1431.

Anatolian frontier of 718-724, 926 and 1111, the western Balkan lobe of 970-979, the Karaman plateau (1192) and Denizli and Paphlagonia (1202): shape changes with no page found in the fourteen opened.

Cyprus 653-960 (condominium) and its overlap with Cliopatria's Cyprus Condominium row; Armenia 638-691 and the 661 return; Africa 647-698: pages Cyprus in the Middle Ages, Muslim conquest of Armenia, Exarchate of Africa, Muslim conquest of the Maghreb not opened.

Thessalonica 1403-1430 (Venetian sale 1423, Ottoman capture 1430), Palaiologan Anatolia 1305-1326, the Morea 1262-1428, Epirus and Thessaly 1333-1337: pages Siege of Thessalonica (1422-1430), Byzantine Empire under the Palaiologos dynasty, Anatolian beyliks, Treaty of Gallipoli not opened.

Norman conquest of Apulia and Calabria 1041-1071, the Catepanate of Italy, Dalmatia and Raska 1000-1170 (pages Norman conquest of southern Italy, Catepanate of Italy, Theme of Dalmatia, Byzantine Empire under the Komnenos dynasty).
Mystras as the seat 1454-1460 (identity.capitals and the 1453 capital_move) is flagged confidence 1: the extract of the Despotate of the Morea page did not name the seat.

problems: Attempt 1 at the Arab-Byzantine wars page used the wrong title (Byzantine-Arab_wars) and returned URL_NOT_FOUND; Arab-Byzantine_wars worked. Page budget: 14 distinct pages opened (the brief's ceiling), plus that one failed attempt.
The Phase A 'Resuming' rule did not apply: no earlier report or dossier existed for eu-05-b.
One validator warning remains and is deliberate: ledger vassal_end of 'ghassanids' in 633 closes the vassal_start of 629 recorded in the eastern-roman-empire dossier.

Gazetteer quirks: 'Philadelphia' and 'Syracuse' resolve to US cities (use lon/lat discs or 'Siracusa'); 'Pentapolis' resolves to Libyan Cyrenaica; an empty 'minus' operand raises NoneType not iterable instead of a gazetteer error; 'Edessa' is unknown to the gazetteer (Sanliurfa works for the Anatolian Edessa).

Cliopatria's Byzantine row has no shape for 1227-1278 and its 1206-1226 and 1468-1474 shapes are residue (12 and 2 island cells); this dossier takes over the 'Nicaean Empire' row's 1260 and 1272 shapes as new keyframes byzantine-empire_1261 and _1272, as the nicaean-empire dossier asks. The Cliopatria row ends 1474 but the state ends 1460 (the Morea).

Keyframe verdicts follow the brief's rule that 'adjust' is for shapes wrong across most of their span: only 647-655 (Africa missing) and 1407 (Thessalonica) are adjusted; the other early-or-late drops (Ravenna 741-749, Rome 768, Egypt 641, Cyrenaica to 665, Tripolitania to 673, Africa to 704, Cyprus 875-885, Afyon 718-723) are 'ok' with the sub-interval in the ledger. The reviewer may prefer 'adjust' for some.

Counterpart strings without a slug are kept as the pages give them (Emirate of Melitene, Kingdom of Kars, Philaretos Brachamios, Peter II Delyan's revolt, Zaccaria lordship of Chios, David III of Tao); 'kingdom-of-cyprus' (Cliopatria, begins 1192) stands for the Cyprus loss of 1192 on Cliopatria's authority, not the page's.
